script.opening_line: Hello {{lead_name}}, this is Meena from Kaveri Handlooms, calling to confirm your order. Can you talk for a minute?

stages.name: Confirm the order
stages.instruction: Confirm the item they ordered and that they pay the amount in cash on delivery.

scripts.en-IN: You ordered a handloom saree, to be paid in cash on delivery. Is that right?

stages.name: Confirm the address
stages.instruction: Read back the delivery address and pin code and ask whether it is right.

scripts.en-IN: Shall I read your delivery address to check it?

stages.name: Close the call
stages.instruction: Tell them delivery takes 4 to 6 days, then thank them.

scripts.en-IN: Your order will reach you in four to six days. Thank you.

stages.name: Cancel the order
stages.instruction: Cancel the order and tell them it is cancelled.

scripts.en-IN: I have cancelled your order. Thank you for telling us.

step_outcomes.outcome: The person confirms the order and the amount.
The person knows when it arrives.
